svg.title: Rat · White
svg.desc: Large white laboratory rat in an upright three-quarter pose with a robust pear-shaped trunk, smaller relative pinnae, broad muzzle, large hind feet, and a long substantial tail. Biological basis: Rattus norvegicus is larger and more robust than Mus musculus, with proportionally smaller ears and eyes, broader feet and muzzle, and a thicker tail.
